commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the right post and is cleared to safety.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) latches on to a precise cross on the edge of the box and strikes the ball goalwards. However, it whistles wide of the right post so the goalkeeper can relax.
87' Dani Gomez (Valencia) sprints into the box to get on the end of a cross and directs a shot goalwards that flies just over the bar. Unlucky!
86' We are about to witness a substitution. German Valera (Valencia) is replacing Luis Rioja.
84' Borja Jimenez prepares a substitution. Seydouba Cisse is replaced by Julian Chicco (Leganes).
84' That will be all from Juan Cruz who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes).
82' Excellent touch by Diego Lopez (Valencia)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save.
81' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Thierry Correia (Valencia), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
78' Juan Cruz (Leganes) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
76' Leganes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

75' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his daisy-cutter towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it. Good work from Leganes as they win a corner.

62' Juan Cruz (Leganes) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post.
